[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (string: String) : List String :=
let rec loop (acc: List String) (rest: String) : List String :=
  match rest with
  | "" => acc
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_prefix := head :: acc.last?
    loop (new_prefix :: acc) tail
loop [] string
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_length := by
  simp
  rw [List.length]
  simp
  rw [String.length]
  simp
